cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: The Pattern
cards.instruction: Treat every minor detail as evidence of a much larger problem.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Two office biscuits are missing. We've got an organised operation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. A confession this quick suggests training.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then they're recruiting through hunger. This goes higher than the biscuit tin.

mechanism: A treats two missing biscuits and B mundane explanations as systemic evidence, correcting the supposed scope of an investigation with strained audit expertise.
confusable: Generic suspicion accuses a person; D24 requires each small fact to widen the problem, while S03 makes A insist on expert analysis over the simple answer.
comparison: Email alternative inflates a personal oversight into organisational fragility; biscuit scene escalates ordinary appetite into a control failure.
seedUse: Missing biscuits, admission and hunger derive from D24-a; S03 replaces unsupported conspiracy with precise but disproportionate stock-control diagnosis.
